C0202.title: Jiangsu Suqian: Zong and Others Used Bot Farm Software to Inflate Livestream and Fan Circle Metrics
C0202.summary: The Suqian Public Security Bureau in Jiangsu Province found that Zong and others set up a workshop, purchased multiple bot farm software and numerous mobile phones, and illegally controlled a large number of online accounts to provide paid services for artificially inflating reposts, likes, and comments for the livestreaming industry and fan circles.
